construct: PRKAR1A encodes the regulatory subunit type I-alpha of cAMP-dependent protein kinase A. Loss of this tumor-suppressor regulatory subunit increases PKA signaling and predisposes to cardiac myxomas, lentigines, endocrine tumors/overactivity, and schwannomas.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Recurrent cardiac myxomas, lentigines, PPNAD, and a PRKAR1A variant establish Carney complex. PRKAR1A is a PKA regulatory subunit/tumor suppressor, so loss increases PKA activity.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Ras-MAPK, reduced Gs signaling, JAK-STAT, and RYR calcium release are unrelated to the direct PRKAR1A regulatory-subunit mechanism.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The endocrine and tumor phenotype plus explicit PRKAR1A genotype remove Carney-triad confusion; the signaling direction is increased, not decreased, PKA activity.
